title: Data retention
description: How long each kind of record is kept. A rule does nothing until you turn it on; then a nightly job purges or anonymises the records older than the days set.
holds: Records under a legal hold are never purged or anonymised, whatever the rules say. Place or release holds before turning a rule on.

actionHelp.purge: Older {{subject}} records are deleted, with what refers to them.
actionHelp.anonymise: Older {{subject}} records are kept, but what identifies a person is overwritten.

daysHelp: At least {{min}}; the default is {{def}}. Applied at the next nightly run.
minDays: Keep records for at least {{n}} days.
